calibration.selectionRule: Embed the byte-exact phone and desktop raw-capsule sample objects from three independent one-attempt candidate runs (20260820-arc1a-absolute-deadline-candidate8, 20260820-arc1a-absolute-deadline-candidate9, and 20260820-arc1a-absolute-deadline-candidate10) plus paired baseline run 20260820-arc1a-absolute-deadline-baseline5. Reduce every embedded raw capsule rather than trusting copied metrics, faults, or outcome rows. All samples use exact isolated Edg/151.0.4129.86, revision @083e754915c9ab93da1d8f7b9c860e4520273900, JavaScript 15.1.23.7, protocol 1.3, and measurement authority f9710bdfaac255d7df7e8c29f251c8387041abe99a0178667b7b3430110a0409. Candidate samples use producer authority 1c8200d7a5ab71341be0f808c242f250b529a3ead4c8cf551cbdf99bebd405c2 and commit cbe786816cafd196a4b1649b0d1b72966036b7cc; baseline5 uses collector commit cbe786816cafd196a4b1649b0d1b72966036b7cc against legacy product commit 38447019517147319bd08c598202d097ee866874. For every profile and field choose a ceiling strictly above the observed three-run maximum, with fractional or +1 sentinels below the next reachable integer or 132px resource quantum for product-owned exact caps and documented rational headroom for variable heap, DOM, encoded-byte, and warm-range fields; require the paired baseline to retain all four sealed faults and multiple ceiling breaches.
